headline: European Natural Gas Edges Up to 85.50 Euros per Megawatt-Hour
summary: Benchmark European natural gas contracts rose 0.9% to trade at 85.5 euros per megawatt-hour on the Title Transfer Facility hub in Amsterdam at the open of European trading.
why: Dutch TTF gas futures serve as the continental pricing benchmark for natural gas, heavily influencing power prices and industrial production costs across Europe.

impacts.name: Dutch TTF Natural Gas
impacts.why: Wholesale gas futures gained 0.9% to reach 85.5 euros per MWh on European energy exchanges.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
